COST SECTION:
- Supplier Cost (ex VAT): What appears on the invoice
- Qty in Purchase Unit: If buying a pack of 10 for £18.50 total then qty=10 and unit cost=£1.85
- Previous Unit Cost: Last batch cost - for tracking inflation
- Cost Change %: Auto-calc: (new-old)/old * 100
- Cost Change Flag: >5% = REVIEW (check if sell price needs updating)
MARGIN SECTION:
- Target Margin %: From strategy doc margin guidelines by category
- Base Sell Price (ex VAT): Auto-calc: cost / (1 - target margin)
- Rounded Sell Price: Human-adjusted to customer-friendly number
- Actual Margin %: Auto-calc: (sell - cost) / sell * 100
- Margin Flag: <25% = LOW | 25-55% = OK | >55% = HIGH-CHECK
COMPETITOR SECTION:
- Track inc VAT prices (what customer sees)
- Our Price vs Avg %: negative = we are cheaper than average
- Competitor Flag: >15% above avg = EXPENSIVE | within 15% = OK | below avg = COMPETITIVE
- Is Reference Product: Y = customers actively price-compare this item (keep sharp)
DECISION SECTION:
- Pricing Decision: Keep / Adjust Up / Adjust Down / Match Competitor / Loss Leader
